note: Catalog of verified external scientific methodologies, equations, target milestones, and license constraints. Do not issue work cards until the designated milestone.

methods.name: empirical_game_theoretic_analysis
methods.mathematical_formulation: Zero-sum game linear program (max v s.t. M^T x >= v*1, sum(x)=1) + Replicator Dynamics (dx_i/dt = x_i[(Mx)_i - x^T M x]) over empirical archetype payoff matrix
primary_sources: Wellman, M. P. (AAAI 2006): Methods for Empirical Game-Theoretic Analysis
Lanctot et al. (NeurIPS 2017): A Unified Game-Theoretic Approach to Multiagent Reinforcement Learning (PSRO)

license_safety.Gambit: GPLv2 (Fenced: do not import code; use SciPy HiGHS LP solver)

methods.actionable_use: Proves field equilibrium deck mix and optimal counter-strategy from measured census without ad-hoc heuristic claims.

methods.name: fishtest_pentanomial_sprt
methods.mathematical_formulation: Paired-game observation over {LL=0, LD=0.25, WL/DD=0.5, WD=0.75, WW=1.0}; Generalized SPRT LLR = (N/2)*ln[(s^2 + (x_bar - mu0)^2) / (s^2 + (x_bar - mu1)^2)]; Normalized Elo = (x_bar - 0.5)/s * (800 / ln(10))
primary_sources: Van den Bergh, M. (2014): Generalized Sequential Probability Ratio Test for Fishtest
Stockfish Development Team: Stockfish Fishtest Pentanomial Model

license_safety.stockfish_fishtest: GPLv3 (Fenced: clean-room mathematical implementation only; no code borrowing)

methods.actionable_use: Captures paired-game win/loss covariance across identical seeds and eliminates draw-rate distortion during candidate filtering.

methods.name: aivat_control_variates
methods.target_milestone: Phase A3 RL Selfplay & Tournament Evaluation (post-BC0)
methods.mathematical_formulation: Unbiased outcome estimator Y* = Y - sum(V(s_t, a_t) - E_pi[V(s_t, a)]) - sum(V(s_t, c_t) - E_P[V(s_t, c)]); variance reduction factor = (1 - rho_{Y,V}^2)
primary_sources: Burch, Schmid, Moravcik, Bowling (AAAI 2018): AIVAT: A New Variance Reduction Technique for Imperfect Information Games
Moravcik et al. (Science 2017): DeepStack: Expert-Level Artificial Intelligence in Heads-Up No-Limit Poker

license_safety.implementation: Clean-room statistical estimator over owned value net

methods.actionable_use: Subtracts baseline state value expectations from match outcomes to reduce sample size requirements by 2-4x for statistical significance.

methods.name: hidden_hand_bayesian_inference
methods.target_milestone: Post-Wall Advanced Kit (In-Person Finals / Best-of-3 Adaptation)
methods.mathematical_formulation: P(Deal D | History h) proportional to P(D) * prod_{t in opp turns} P(a_t | S_t, D); weighted ISMCTS rollout Q_hat(s, a) = sum(w_k * Q(s(D_k), a))
primary_sources: Ginsberg, M. L. (JAIR 2001): GIB: Imperfect Information in a Computationally Challenging Game
Buro et al. (IJCAI 2009): Solving Skat Using Bayesian Determinization
methods.actionable_use: Replaces uniform random card shuffling with posterior deal sampling weighted by observed opponent play history.

methods.name: safe_opponent_exploitation_rnr
methods.mathematical_formulation: Maximum safe deviation delta_exploit <= BankedSurplus / RemainingGames; Restricted Nash Response sigma_RNR = argmax_sigma u(sigma, sigma_opp_hat) s.t. min_sigma' u(sigma, sigma') >= v* - epsilon
primary_sources: Ganzfried & Sandholm (ACM EC 2011): Game Theory-Based Opponent Modeling in Large Imperfect-Information Games
Johanson, Zinkevich, Bowling (AAMAS 2007): Response to Opponent Modeling in Imperfect Information Games
methods.actionable_use: Bounds exploitative deviations against observed opponent tendencies to guarantee worst-case score does not drop below game value.

methods.name: clark_bivariate_normal_maximum
methods.mathematical_formulation: E[max(X1, X2)] = mu1*Phi(alpha) + mu2*Phi(-alpha) + theta*phi(alpha), where theta = sqrt(sig1^2 + sig2^2 - 2*rho*sig1*sig2) and alpha = (mu1 - mu2)/theta
primary_sources: Clark, C. E. (Operations Research, 1961): The Greatest of a Finite Set of Random Variables
Harter, H. L. (Biometrika, 1961): Expected Values of Normal Order Statistics
methods.actionable_use: Evaluates exact expected value of independent candidate fires versus duplicate submissions.

methods.name: instability_scaled_time_budgeting
methods.mathematical_formulation: T_move = (T_bank - T_reserve)/M_rem * (1 + kappa * exp(-|Q1 - Q2| / sigma_Q)) with hard reserve floor T_reserve = 15s
primary_sources: Markovitch & Sella (AIJ 1996): Learning to Allocate Search Time in Real-Time Search
Cowling, Ward, Powley (IEEE TCIAIG 2012): Information Set MCTS in Card Games
methods.actionable_use: Allocates search time dynamically, speeding through obvious decisions and spending deep time on pivotal branch points.
